_comment: ICD-9-CM code prefixes (no dots) used to label outcomes in the MIMIC-III (BIDMC) newborn cohort. A diagnosis matches an outcome if its code starts with any listed prefix. These are standard neonatal ICD-9 codes provided as a starting point; the exact code lists used in the paper are given in its appendix. Death is taken from ADMISSIONS.HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG.
